root_idea.summary: A semantic field of distance and remoteness: being far away, at an extremity, or set apart.
root_idea.development: The field includes an abstract noun for distance, adjectives for remote and farthest places, and intransitive and causative verbs for withdrawing or putting at a distance. The lexical discussion also records specialized camel terminology, including an ear-cutting verb and terms for camels kept apart from use.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized elative headword أَقْصَى, covering its Quranic attributive and substantivized uses.
Displayed as the distinct adjectival headword قَصِيّ for the meaning “distant” or “remote”.
Displayed as the distinct feminine elative headword قُصْوَىٰ for a farther or farthest side or region.

senses.definition: Farthest or most remote; the farthest part, side, or end.
senses.usage_conditions: Used attributively with a place noun and substantivized for a remote extremity or locality, as in the farthest mosque and the farthest part of a city.
An adjectival description of something far away; the Quranic occurrence describes a remote location.

senses.definition: The farther or farthest; the more remote side or region.
senses.usage_conditions: A feminine elative adjective qualifying a place or side; in the Quran it denotes the farther bank or side.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun for being far away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become distant; to go away from.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن for withdrawal or distance from someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put at a distance; to remove or drive away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative verb expresses making someone or something distant or removing it from a place or association.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut a camel’s ear; a camel or she-camel with a cut ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb denotes the ear-cutting action; قَصْوَاء and أَقْصَى are recorded as descriptors for the resulting camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel kept apart from use or set aside from the working herd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term used of camels that are remote from ordinary use.

cautions: No Lane primary or Maqayis evidence was supplied; the lexical coverage and root orientation therefore rely on the matched Mufradat entry together with the canonical QAC forms.
The أَقْصَى Quranic form group contains both adjective and substantivized noun tags, which are covered within one public form and sense.
